method.disclosures: Publication date from provider metadata, not independently audited original PDF. Entry at close of the first full IHSG session strictly after publication date; 5/20-session price response versus same-date IHSG. Intraday timestamp/timezone availability unverified. Overlapping disclosure events are not pooled into a strategy or causal effect.
method.analog: Same issuer, same close/SMA50/SMA200 regime and Z20 bucket (<-1, -1..1, >1) as latest observation. Features use only current/past data. 20-session horizon, next-session close entry. Candidates spaced >21 sessions; selection/cooldown before outcome guards. Only matured, complete positive-price/volume paths, no >40% jumps. Historical matched conditions, not a forecast.
method.evaluation: Chronological quarterly monitoring of fixed net-buy-positive/Z20>=2 events from Screener, next-close entry, non-overlap. Prior sample counts include only events whose 20D exit precedes the quarter. No fitted model or genuine prospective holdout: retrospective fixed-rule walk-forward diagnostic, not validated alpha.
method.cost: 0/10/25 bps per side on both issuer and same-date IHSG proxy: (1+gross)*(1-c)/(1+c)-1. These are sensitivity assumptions, not observed execution fees. No leverage, dividends, impact or executable index product.
method.limits: Current LQ45 membership, not historical membership; raw price adjustment unverified. Small dependent samples; Wilson hit-rate CI is exploratory, not return CI or prediction probability. Report snapshot values are not historical features. Filings response is provider text, not independently audited source-document content. No legal clearance inferred.

Agenda #1: Approval of transfer of up to 100,000,000 shares from the third buyback period (16 March 2026 to 15 June 2026) for the management share ownership program (MSOP), with authority delegated to the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and the Board of Directors. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee is authorized to set the exercise price and payment obligation, and the Board of Directors is authorized to take necessary actions for MSOP implementation. Voting results: 26,391,450,625 agreed, 6,250,753,164 disagreed, 188,912,237 abstained.
Agenda #2: Approval of a share buyback of up to Rp8,000,000,000,000 under POJK No. 29/2023, with authority given to the Board of Directors to execute the buyback, including determining the buyback price and taking necessary actions. Voting results: 32,641,350,427 agreed, 1,441,900 disagreed, 188,323,699 abstained.

corporate_actions.agm_place: Catur Dharma Hall, Menara Astra Lt.5, JL. Jenderal Sudirman KAV 5-6 Dki. Jakarta / Kota Adm. Jakarta Pusat (Registrasi Ditutup 09.30 WIB Atau Lebih Cepat Jika Jumlah Pemegang Sahamfisik Telah Mencapai 450 Orang)
corporate_actions.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report, the Board of Commissioners' Oversight Report, and the audited Consolidated Financial Statements, granting full discharge to the Board and Directors. The financial statements received a "fairly stated" opinion in the report dated February 26, 2026.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved a total cash dividend of Rp 390 per share and allocated a minimum of Rp 17.10 trillion of the Rp 32.77 trillion net profit to retained earnings. A final dividend of Rp 292 per share is scheduled for payment on May 25, 2026.
Agenda #3: Prijono Sugiarto was appointed President Commissioner and Rudy as President Director, with most board members' terms set to run until the 2029 Annual General Meeting. The meeting established the full board composition, including specific directors and commissioners and their respective independence and term periods.
Agenda #4: Shareholders approved a maximum monthly honorarium of Rp 2.16 billion gross for the Board of Commissioners and authorized the Board to determine salaries and benefits for Directors. This mandate is effective from April 23, 2026, until the 2027 Annual General Meeting.
Agenda #5: KAP Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan (PwC) and Buntoro Rianto were appointed to audit the company's 2026 financial statements. The Board of Directors was authorized to determine the honorarium and terms of the appointment.

broker.reason: Ranking deskriptif hanya untuk kode broker dalam arsip lokal. Hash file cocok dengan inventaris, tetapi endpoint asal belum tercatat dan cakupan bukan seluruh broker. Kode broker bukan identitas pemilik manfaat.
broker.method: Net = sum(bval) − sum(sval). Pembeli: net positif terbesar; penjual: net negatif terbesar secara absolut. Periode memakai tanggal record yang tersedia pada semua kode broker; missing tidak diisi nol. Porsi = (beli+jual broker)/sum(beli+jual seluruh broker dalam sampel), bukan pangsa seluruh pasar; transaksi antarbroker dapat terhitung pada kedua sisi.
